findings.desc: CHK-008:edge:1 is marked covered by packages/main/src/tasks/unattended-dispatch-smoke.ts, but that smoke only asserts cancellation, accepted review, missing policy, unavailable/unattendedUnsafe host, and authority invariants (see lines 271-459). It does not exercise the required timeout, missing-receipt, or mixed-worker-outcome paths. Those scenarios only appear in dispatch-run-smoke under CHK-007 (e.g. missing transcript/receipt at 1777-1830 and mixed worker outcomes at 1833-1853), so the recorded evidence/test-evidence overclaims final CHK-008 edge coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit e10e5a85 by expanding packages/main/src/tasks/unattended-dispatch-smoke.ts CHK-008 edge coverage to assert timeout, missing receipt diagnostics, mixed worker outcomes, out-of-policy path/command refusal, and denied env filtering. Re-verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:dispatch-run-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:unattended-dispatch-smoke, and refreshed verification evidence in 1b567ca/d739983.

findings.desc: dispatch_auto authorizes on env and runtime policy fields that the fake unattended runner never enforces. checkDispatchPolicy requires env and runtime metadata (packages/main/src/core/dispatch-policy.ts:385-409), but runRequiredCommands executes child commands with execSync using the parent process environment and no timeout or env override (packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:1330-1343). Verified in an isolated temp repo: policy envAllowlist=[] and envDenylist=[REVIEW_LANE_SECRET], then dispatch_auto with a fake requiredCommand that writes process.env.REVIEW_LANE_SECRET still returned status=accepted_local and produced leakedValue=lane-secret-value. That means unattended jobs can read caller secrets despite an explicit denylist, and maxRuntimeMinutes is likewise not enforced on the execution path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit e10e5a85 by running dispatch_auto fake required commands with policy-filtered env derived from envAllowlist/envDenylist and per-command maxRuntimeMinutes timeout; runner metadata records filtered env summary and timedOut. Re-verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:dispatch-run-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:unattended-dispatch-smoke, and refreshed verification evidence in 1b567ca/d739983.

findings.desc: dispatch_auto does not enforce policy scope or command allowlists before execution. buildPack copies caller-supplied allowedPaths and requiredCommands directly into the pack (packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:945-969), dispatchAuto only checks host and maxParallel before forwarding the original args into runDispatch (2203-2273), and the fake runner executes pack.requiredCommands verbatim (1544-1556). Verified in an isolated temp repo using built dist handlers: a policy with allowedPaths=[packages/main/src/generated/] and commandAllowlist=[node -e process.exit(0)] still accepted dispatch_auto with allowedPaths=[README.md] and requiredCommands=[node -e require(fs).writeFileSync(UNSAFE-CMD.txt,x)], returned status=accepted_local, and created the file. This breaks the user-approved host/path/command boundary promised by the story.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit e10e5a85 by binding dispatch_auto allowedPaths/deniedPaths/requiredCommands to the selected policy before runDispatch and refusing out-of-policy scope or commandAllowlist violations before dispatch artifacts are created. Re-verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:dispatch-run-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:unattended-dispatch-smoke, and refreshed verification evidence in 1b567ca/d739983.
